name: memory_dream
description: Trigger a generative memory replay (dream) cycle across episodic and semantic memory. Recombines salient engrams, simulates hypothetical trajectories, ingests novel synthesized insights, and inhibits inconsistent counter-associations. Supports REM (weak constraint associative replay, default), DAYDREAM (moderate constraint wandering), and THOUGHT_EXPERIMENT (tight constraint counterfactual simulation). Returns telemetry metrics including scenes constructed, insights ingested, and journal entries written.

mode.description: Dream mode determining generative temperature and constraint relaxation: 'REM' (default, weak constraints, temp 2.0), 'DAYDREAM' (moderate constraints, temp 1.0), 'THOUGHT_EXPERIMENT' (tight constraints, temp 0.5).

namespace.description: Target memory namespace (slug or ID). Omit to use connection or account default.
